# ZBoard 0.0.1

The first public release of ZBoard, a basic management panel for Zero nodes, users and subscriptions.

- Manage node assets, protocol services and configuration delivery.
- Create plans, manage users and orders, and deliver subscription configurations.
- Track traffic and subscription usage from the user console.
- Configure network fronting, shared proxy pools, DNS and certificates.
- Deploy with Docker Compose using MySQL or SQLite storage.

ZBoard focuses on the basic panel. Online payments and other business extensions belong to plugins. This release does not include the plugin runtime added later on the development branch.

Start with the [installation guide](https://docs.zerodenet.org/projects/zboard/guides/installation). Release assets include platform binaries, deployment files and checksums.
